gate_definition: All-cloud Walking Skeleton passes with channel/runtime simulators and loopback transport; real adapters are additionally verified when activated.

criteria.name: stage1_state_and_frozen_evidence
criteria.evidence: CB-100 through CB-140 are 5/5 passed; their five evidence tree hashes, implementation commits, closure commits and 15 Acceptance mappings match the frozen input.

criteria.name: host_layout_and_runtime_toolchain
criteria.evidence: Non-root systemd layout, 100 restart/singleton Oracles, pinned Node/Codex, disabled Claude adapter and clean activation states remain valid.

criteria.name: bounded_workspace_and_identity
criteria.evidence: The blob:none sparse workspace, alias/realpath boundary, code/data identity negatives and no-clone plan-only client evidence remain valid.

criteria.name: supervised_loopback_process_family
criteria.evidence: One systemd cgroup, one supervisor, loopback-only Runtime/status/channel, 100 restart/singleton cases and 4/4 fault recovery remain valid.

criteria.name: walking_skeleton_and_policy
criteria.evidence: Fresh executable tests passed; frozen target evidence records 10/10 complete simulator chains and Runtime-call deltas 0/1/0 for unauthorized, 32768 and 32769-byte inputs.

criteria.name: trace_latency_and_privacy
criteria.evidence: Twenty latency samples passed at P50 372 ms/P95 378 ms; correlated evidence contains no raw message, result or identity content.

criteria.name: mac_offline_and_network
criteria.evidence: Mac runtime source/process/connector hits and non-loopback Runtime connections/listeners are zero; prior three-attempt external port scans passed.

criteria.name: credential_free_security_and_license
criteria.evidence: The 15-command isolated matrix, App 175/175 and secret scan passed; strict dual-license obligations and unresolved conflict record remain preserved without upstream clarification.

criteria.name: target_publication_and_next_boundary
criteria.evidence: Fresh target metadata is quiescent with candidate inactive and current/workspace unchanged; GitHub branch/PR/tag/release are zero and CB-200 remains not_started.
